summary: Code-review-driven cleanup verified. (1) Backend pytest suite: all 40 tests PASS both with TEST_ADMIN_* unset (using admin@arenaops.gg/admin123 fallback) and with TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD exported to the same values. (2) Frontend LogMatch & EditMatchDialog format switching (1v1 <-> 2v2 <-> 3v3) renders correct slot counts with the new composite ${side}-${i} keys, no React key warnings, match submission succeeds, Edit dialog opens and format toggles cleanly. (3) Smoke: admin can log/edit matches, viewer gets 403 on write (POST /api/players returned 403), duplicate-player + duplicate-champion-in-team server-side validations enforced.

minor.issue: Fixture used identical champion ('Bakko' / 'Jumong') for every player on each team, which now collides with the duplicate-champion-per-team validation. Fixed in-place by varying champions per slot (Bakko/Croak/Rook on A, Jumong/Varesh/Pearl on B). Unrelated to the current env-var change but was blocking the full-suite run.

When run with -n auto, test_leaderboard_format.py's cleanup deletes the (sole) seeded season while test_match_validation.py concurrently uses the 'active' season, causing intermittent 404s. Pass rate is 100% when run serially. Pre-existing coupling, not caused by this review.

action_items: Optional: decouple test_leaderboard_format.py's season cleanup from the 'active' season assumption in test_match_validation.py so parallel xdist runs are deterministic (match_validation could create its own TEST_ season instead of reusing the active one).
critical_code_review_comments: env-var-driven admin credentials in the three pytest files are correctly implemented with os.environ.get(..., default).
Composite key ${side}-${i} in LogMatch.jsx:102 and EditMatchDialog.jsx:77 is stable across format switches; no console key warnings observed in the browser automation run.

Minor: test_viewer_role.py and test_match_validation.py have duplicate `import os` statements (harmless but noisy). test_leaderboard_format.py uses a hardcoded fallback URL in BASE_URL - prefer failing fast like test_viewer_role.py.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_leaderboard_format.py (fixture: vary champions per slot to satisfy duplicate-champion validation)
seed_data_creation: test_leaderboard_format.py creates TEST_LB_* season + 6 TEST_P* players + 7 matches and cleans up. test_match_validation.py creates 4 TEST_DupVal_* players and cleans up. One TEST_e2e 2v2 match was logged via the UI test; left in DB (prefixed note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite is clean at 40/40 serially. If you need parallel xdist, be aware test_leaderboard_format cleanup can race with test_match_validation's active-season assumption. The in-UI composite slot keys were verified via Playwright - format switching across 1v1/2v2/3v3 preserves slot[0] data correctly in Edit dialog and resets cleanly in Log Match.
